name: SLGC Berhad
overview: SLGC Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市，首次公开募股（IPO）公开发行105,000,000股新股。公司业务线包括建筑施工服务、外部及附属工程、项目管理服务、分包商管理以及设计与建造服务，但所提供的公告中未披露各业务板块的具体变化。
overview_en: SLGC Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026 through an initial public offering (IPO) involving a public issue of 105,000,000 new ordinary shares. The company's business lines include building construction services, external and ancillary works, project management services, subcontractor management, and design and build services, but the announcements provided do not disclose specific changes in each business segment.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成首次公开募股并在ACE市场上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market in 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") C
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股，公开发行105,000,000股新股，配合在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering, involving a public issue of 105,000,000 new shares, in conjunction with its listing on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
